title: Connected impressions sustain hope

captions.emotions: Feeling the possibility of further discovery

meaning: Connecting impressions through observable details can develop shared meaning and bring a feeling that further discovery remains possible for both people.
text: Hope for understanding can rest on relationships between different impressions. Temperance in the physical position of Ajna suggests jointly connecting them through observable details. The Empress in energy supports developing meaning from concrete material. The Star in emotions feels the possibility of further discovery. Difference can pleasingly leave a shared subject. Attention gives each discovery a place where it can enrich the question being considered together by both people.

Suppose one person experiences a courtyard as enclosed while the other finds it sheltered. You relate impressions to high walls and an open patch of sky. **Connecting impressions can give hope a concrete foundation.** Wanting understanding to develop reveals enclosed space’s relationship with light. Two responses gain connection without complete agreement. Hope arises from available continuation: details changing a boundary’s feeling can be considered. Your view preserves each personal experience through the place’s visible arrangement without proving that another example must produce the same understandable response in both people.

The risk is noticing only details supporting a connected picture because its continuation seems promising. Wanting meaning to develop preserves an inconvenient feature too. One courtyard showed a particular relationship between walls and light. Your view can grow through observations while another place alters understanding without making this connection explain every feeling of openness or protection for both people.
